summary: This RFC defines a Telnet option for marking the end of a record in data sent over a Telnet connection. It is a proposed standard. Some applications need clear record boundaries in what would otherwise be a plain stream of characters.

eli5.summary: When you read a stream of letters, you need a full stop to know where one sentence ends. This option adds one so the other computer knows where a record stops.

questions: how to mark end of record in telnet
